facts.activity_file: isolating and depressuring a leaking system
facts.activity_series: responding to a loss of containment

control_failures.control_label: secondary containment by bund and drainage
controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels
integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: uncontrolled movement of TK-7102 during routine operation

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was lost time injury, with 1 person injured and 4 days lost.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the secondary containment by bund and drainage on TK-7102, LT-7102 and PSV-7102 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. TK-7102 (product storage tanks) is in service for export product storage. The task proceeded during routine operation while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 29 February 2016 an incident occurred on TK-7102, LT-7102 and PSV-7102 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during routine operation, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
